name: SIIC Environment Holdings Ltd.
summary: SIIC Environment Holdings Ltd., an investment holding company, engages in the wastewater treatment, water supply, sludge treatment, waste-to-energy, and other environment related businesses primarily in the People's Republic of China. It operates through three segments: Water and Sludge Treatment, Water Supply, and Waste-to-Energy. The Water and Sludge Treatment segment constructs, manages, and operates water and sludge related infrastructure under service concession arrangements; and manages and operates water and sludge related infrastructure under non-service concession arrangements, as well as provides financial income under service concession arrangements.
